en: We're now entering Fiena's realm.
Lots of flowers and vines.
Flowery smell... My nose feels numb.
If you smell them for too long, you might end up like her.
To avoid that, you need...
A tool... or a spell?
No.
You just have to smash through the monsters that come at us and run straight to Fiena.
...I see.
Let's go.
She should be around here...
Over there!
Tweet tweet.
Fiena. It's time for the tea party.
Cheep cheep!!
Let's go, Fiena.
Chirp chirp! I'm a little birdie!
Leave me alone!! Hoohoohoo!
She's not listening.
Same old Fiena.
I'll use my scythe—
Abigail!!
You can't just try to decapitate others if you don't get your way.
At times like this, it's best to just tire her out until she returns to her senses.
Weehehehehehe!! I'm going to fly far, far away! HIC!!
H-Hey!!
I was a bird, flying freely through the skies...
Hehehe! What happened?
See? When someone won't listen, you just need to talk with your fists.
Okay, I'll remember that.
What, are you two doing here?
It's Abigail first time in the garden alone.
So I decided to be her guide.
It's so nice to see you two together.
Now you've got some sense knocked back into you, get ready to join the tea party.
Aha! It's already that time?
Let's go.
You're more enthusiastic to get this done than I expected.
The sooner we're done, the sooner I can go back to my farm.
Ah...
Well, there's no harm in that, I suppose.
Let's hurry.
See you at the tea party!
I should warn you before we go in...
I'm sure you already know this, but...
Rims and Berry are by far the most uncooperative witches when it comes to the tea party.
And they're always out for flesh and blood.
Don't fall for anything they say.
Oh my, oh my, gossipping about other witches, are we? Don't you value your life?
Ta-da!
But what's this?
This isn't the usual customer...?
Abigail is in charge of invites for this year's tea party.
Aha, I remember.
So why are you here too, Sil?
I could hardly send Abigail into a place like this on her own.
Hmph, what's that supposed to mean?
Yeah, I'm sure Abigail would have loved to play with us!
Sit down and enjoy our show, Abigail. Our service is second to none.
Hehehehe.
I never understand what those two are talking about.
This time is no different.
I know how you feel.
...Though I am a little curious.
You are?!
Don't get your hopes up too much.
This club is no more than a trap to get others' flesh and blood.
...Understood.
Come on in, Abigail.
It's time you finally became a respectable witch through our Witch Game.
Witch Game?
Yes! We fight each other to the death, and the winner gets flesh and blood!
That's how witches talk with one another, got it?
Got it.
Ignore them, Abigail.
I guess Sil doesn't see eye to eye with us.
You'll just have to experience it yourself.
Have fun! Ahahahahaha!
Oh no!! The new employee we spend so long preparing!
It was fun working together while it lasted...
You're a good fighter, Sil.
Hehe, thanks.
Is it me, Berry, or does Sil seem more smug than usual?
I'm sure it's because Abigail is watching.
You understand how dangerous this club is now, right?
Alright! We better see you two at the tea party.
Sil appears to be looking down on us!
How about it, Rims? Shall we use "that"?
I'm sure it will be fine. We even have a special customer today...
It would be good for Abigail to see Sil be brought down to size!
Don't tell me...
One more round? But that's against the rules!
You really are an incredible witch, Sil!
But you still haven't seen everything our new employee is capable of!
Now the real show will begin!
Huh!?
It was fun while it lasted...
Nightmares are intruding!
...We're late for the tea party.
It's all their fault.
Now, now, Sil. This isn't the time for assigning blame.
We need to hurry up and get to Nahatra.
You wouldn't want the garden to be destroyed, would you? Hehe.
Ugh, you two...
See you at the tea party!
Don't worry, Abigail.
The tea party runs late every year, but it always works out.
Heh...
You recognize this place, right?
It's where we always host the tea party.
...There are always nightmares leaking out when I'm here.
That's because... you're always late.
Don't look at me like that.
It's not like I don't want to have a tea party.
Look at me! I'm doing my best to protect my home... and this garden, right?
Well... maybe.
Right?
So it's the other witches that are bad?
Well, I wouldn't say it so bluntly...
Just know it's not my fault, okay?
Okay. I'll remember that.
Late...
Again.
There were... circumstances. Heh.
I hope you're not late because of more silly fighting.
Abigail doesn't spend much time here, so I was showing her around.
Isn't it good for her to know the garden well?
It will make future tea parties easier too!
You're suddenly so eloquent at times like this.
But, I cannot deny you make a good point, so...
Hmm, all right.
Let's hear what Abigail learned from organizing this tea party.
At least if she learned a good lesson, the next tea party will be worth looking forward to.
Think back on our journey, Abigail...!
First question.
How do you gather your fellow witches for the tea party?
...Beat them up, but not so badly that they die.
...Any other method?
Umm...
Harvest flesh and blood.
Have you not learned anything of worth?
Nothing is Sil's fault.
The other witches are just bad.
...That's what I learned.
I-It's not how it sounds, Chloe!
If anything, I should be thanking you.
Now I don't need to feel so bad about beating you all to a pulp.
Help me, Abigail!
Don't want to.
Ahhh...!
*panting*
Chloe, you're soaked in sweat.
You wicked witch...!
Don't think I'll let you get away that easily!
Sorry, but I don't want to be burned alive!
Uh-oh...
We can't keep wasting time like this, or we'll be in real trouble, Chloe!
We're already in real trouble thanks to your tardiness!
I'll explain after the tea party!
You two get ready for the party.
Playing the role of senior witch isn't as easy as I thought.
Do you have any advice for me, Nahatra?
Sorry to give you nightmares again this year.
I took too long showing Abigail around the garden.
Still, I think it's fun to walk around the garden with the other witches.
Perhaps you should come along and explore the other realms while you can too.
It sounds like you've had your work cut out for you, Sil.
Ha... I wonder if I should put up with Abigail's face...
Don't worry too much.
She'll learn something better on our next garden outing, right?
Chloe called us a bunch of "uneducated kids."
Isn't that a bit harsh?
She's always so angry.
And why is that!?
...I'm going back to my farm.
Hold on a little longer. The tea party's starting soon.
How was it, Abigail?
Do you think you'll be willing to invite the other witches every year now...?
No.
Ugh...
Hehe, just when Sil thought life would be getting easier.
Sil hates having to do all the work every time...
And Chloe wants everyone to arrive on time.
We know exactly who can solve both of those problems.
...Who?
Ta-da! Who else but us!?
...I was a fool for expecting anything better.
Don't worry!
It's going to be so fun, you'll forget every other tea party up to now!
It doesn't have to be fun, you just need to be on time.
This is your final chance.
...What does that mean?
I've reached my limit.
I have to take care of the garden. I have to take care of this place when Nahatra goes to sleep.
I have to keep the garden from falling apart because the tea party isn't happening on time...
I'm fed up.
If the next tea party doesn't happen on time...
I'm canceling all tea party contracts.
Bye.
Will she really stop the tea parties...?
I'd like to stay in the garden for a while longer.
Why's everyone so serious?
Right, stop worrying!
We've got the perfect plan!
Maybe we'll surprise you at the next tea party!
That's the scariest thing I've heard all day.
With a knot woven by the Thread Witch.
With dewdrops brewed by the Flower Witch.
With soil sprinkled by the Pumpkin Witch.
With flesh devoured by the Blood Witch.
With a flame lit by the Wax Witch.
In the name of all witches, we will now host our tea party.
Are you ready?
Almost.
What are you going to do with that letter you got the other day?
Oh, this one...
Dear Sil.
Hi there!
We're getting ready to take the tea party to new heights.
We just need you to come to our club to help us plan it.
With love ♥ Rims & Berry
I've never received a more ominous invitation in my life.
At least they were surprisingly polite.
I was going to ignore it, but...
I'll have to go see for myself. Not knowing what they're preparing would only make me more anxious.
They're preparing for the tea party.
Yes, but I'm sure it won't be any normal tea party.
I'll keep an eye on them to make sure nothing too crazy happens.
You're a real example to all witches.
I'm better than them at least, right?
I guess we'll see...
Hello? Is nobody in?
Why's it so quiet?
I'll have to go in and see...
The place is completely trashed!
What happened here?
Perfect timing, Sil!
What's going on?
It's almost time for the tea party. Have you been preparing?
We have made a grave mistake.
Here we go...
The thing is...
Well, we'll just have to show you! ♡
Introducing...!
Our newest employee!
What's her name I hear you cry?
It's Abigail!
Abigail...?
We'll explain later.
First, we need you to stop her rampage.
At this rate, our realm will collapse regardless of if Nahatra sleeps or not!
*panting*
Calm down, Abigail!
Someone explain to me what's going on.
Why is Abigail rampaging around here?
Well...
We're planning to take R.I.P Club on the road!
Hence we lured—
Ahem! Hence we enlisted Abigail's help as a staff member.
They say a wealth of childhood experience makes a great witch, hehe.
Surely you could have predicted this is what you'd get for pulling such a stunt on Abigail?
Why else do you think we called for you?
You two...
I don't want to wear this.
Ah! It'll tear if you pull it off like that!
There's no need to be so shy, Abigail.
Sil said she'd wear it too!
I did?
Pleeeeeease!
We need your cooperation!
It's all for the sake of the tea party!
You're really not subtle.
But fine, we don't have the time for arguing.
Hyup!
Wow, in the blink of an eye! You're amazing!
Okay, Abigail. If I'm wearing it too, you can put up with it until after the tea party, can't you?
...Fine.
Now all that leaves is Fiena!
It's almost time for Nahatra to sleep.
We should hurry!
I forgot to ask...
What exactly are you planning for the tea party?
Are you going to turn Nahatra's room into some kind of slaughterhouse?
Not at all! We're going for a wholesome concept, actually.
Yeah! We're gonna have our club staff serve Nahatra...
With lots of tasty food and drink!
I just felt a shiver through my whole body...
The problem is, our staff was wiped out during Abigail's rampage.
She also destroyed our tea party materials.
She did!? So your plan is ruined already?
Not at all! We just need to fill in for the staff!
So that's why we're dressed like this...?
And we can all enjoy the drinks we asked Fiena to make.
We'll turn the tea party into a really fun witches' coven!
I never really thought of the tea party like an actual party.
I'm not that kind of witch, to be honest.
There's no reason the tea party needs to remain a boring ritual forever!
Hmm...
Oh? Sil? How unexpected...!
There's are several Sils! One... two...
It's not Sil, it's us!
Hmm? It's strange...
Aha, I get it! One of you must be a fake!
That's okay! I know how to work out the real one!
Let's dance! Dance, dance, dance!! Hehehehe!!
Sure! That sounds like fun!
We're here to bring her to the party, not encourage her behavior!
We need to get her back to her senses!
...As always.
Phew! I don't think I can drink another sip...
Isn't she more intoxicated than usual?
Fiena!!
Wah!? Who's this?
Why, it's Berry and Rims!
She only just recognized them?
Have you finished all the all the horrible, unholy concoctions we asked for?
Of course! There was plenty for everyone!
...Until I drank it all myself... HIC!
Sorry! Hehehehe!
Hahahaha! You're so silly, Fiena!
Hahaha!
Why are you laughing?
Your plan is in tatters!
You know what they say, Sil. Improvise, adapt, overcome.
Stop worrying so much! We have contingencies for our contingencies!
We'll just have to make Fiena another member of our staff for today.
...Fine, let's just go with the flow.
Eh?
Congrats, Fiena!
You've been selected as a special employee of our club for this tea party!
I dunno what that means, but... HIC! ...Thanks!
I'm not sure this is a good idea.
Are we going back to your club now to drink some more?
Hehe, that's not entirely wrong...
There's no time to explain. We have to hurry!
This isn't looking good...
I don't think we'll be able to make it on time.
Not to mention your tea party materials were ruined.
Don't worry, we'll get everything ready while you're busy fighting Chloe.
Can we please not talk like it's a given I'll be fighting Chloe?
Ah, we're 100% late.
...Can't you guys be the ones keeping Chloe occupied while I get the tea party ready?
We're such delicate little witches, we're not good at fighting ♡
Ugh...
